title: Luxury Bali Escape with Mount Batur
alt: Sunrise over the crater rim of Mount Batur, Bali
transport: Private transfers and private guided tours

stops.name: Kuta
stops.subtitle: Kuta to Uluwatu
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 5★ · Beachfront resort on Tuban beach with three pools

activities.name: Uluwatu sunset with Padang Padang
activities.description: A private half day along the southern cliffs: the cove at Padang Padang beach, then Uluwatu temple perched above the surf as the sun goes down.

activities.name: Kuta beach and Kuta Square
activities.description: The long surf beach on your doorstep, with boards for hire, and the shops, bakeries and cafes of Kuta Square a few streets inland.

program.name: Kuta
program.description: Two nights beachfront in the south to begin, with an afternoon along the cliffs at Padang Padang and Uluwatu temple for sunset.

stops.name: Ubud
stops.subtitle: Ubud to Mount Batur and Mount Agung
stops.hotel: The Payogan Villa Resort & Spa, Ubud
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Villa resort in the valley north of Ubud town

activities.name: Central Bali with Tirta Empul
activities.description: A private tour through central Bali: the Tegalalang rice terraces, Tegenungan waterfall and the holy spring temple at Tirta Empul.

activities.name: Mount Batur sunrise trek
activities.description: A guided climb up the volcano in the dark to reach the rim for sunrise, with breakfast cooked in the steam vents at the top.

activities.name: Mount Agung and Besakih temple
activities.description: A private day on the slopes of Bali's highest volcano, taking in Besakih, the mother temple, and the water gardens at Lempuyang.

activities.name: Balinese massage in Ubud
activities.description: A traditional Balinese massage with warm oil and long pressure strokes, booked privately at a spa in Ubud on your free day.

program.name: Ubud
program.description: Four nights in a valley villa with two volcano days, the holy spring temple at Tirta Empul and a spa afternoon to finish.

day_titles.3: Central Bali and on to Ubud

1: Arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport and private transfer to your hotel
Check in at your beachfront resort in Kuta
Rest of the day free by the pool or on the sand
Optional: Kuta Square, the night market or a sunset surf
2: Breakfast, then a private half day to the southern cliffs
Padang Padang beach in its narrow limestone cove
Uluwatu temple above the surf as the sun drops
Optional: the Kecak fire dance in the temple amphitheatre
3: Breakfast and check out, then private transfer up to Ubud
Tegalalang rice terraces and Tegenungan waterfall
The holy spring temple at Tirta Empul
Check in at your villa resort in the Ubud valley
4: Very early start for the guided climb up Mount Batur
Reach the crater rim in time for sunrise over the lake
Breakfast cooked in the volcanic steam at the top
Back at the villa by late morning for a slow afternoon
5: Breakfast, then a private day on the slopes of Mount Agung
Besakih, the mother temple of Bali, on the mountainside
The water gardens and split gate at Lempuyang
Optional: the old village lanes of Penglipuran
6: Breakfast and a free morning at the villa
A traditional Balinese massage at an Ubud spa
Optional: the Monkey Forest or the Saraswati water temple
Optional: dinner above the valley at a hillside restaurant
7: Breakfast at the villa and check out
Private transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: Do the beach first and the volcanoes after. Ubud at the end means you fly home rested rather than sunburnt.
expert.tip: The Batur climb starts around two in the morning, so pack a light jacket, a head torch and trainers with grip. Keep the following afternoon completely free and let the villa spa do the rest.

summary: Seven days split between a beachfront resort in Kuta and a villa in the Ubud valley, with Uluwatu at sunset, the holy spring temple at Tirta Empul, a sunrise trek up Mount Batur and a private day on Mount Agung.
included: Included: 6 nights with daily breakfast; private airport and inter city transfers; Uluwatu and Padang Padang tour; central Bali tour with Tirta Empul; Mount Batur sunrise trek; Mount Agung and Besakih day; a Balinese massage in Ubud.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Indonesia visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
